description: Fluxo do exemplo do CLAUDE.md: tipo → calculada → agrupar por UF.
sql:
WITH "n1" AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM READ_PARQUET('Vendas.parquet')
), "n2" AS (
  SELECT
    "uf",
    "cidade",
    CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(NULLIF(TRIM("data_txt"), ''), '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE) AS "data_txt",
    TRY_CAST(REPLACE(
      REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM("preço_txt"), ''), '^R\$\s*|\s', '', 'g'), '.', ''),
      ',',
      '.'
    ) AS DOUBLE) AS "preço_txt",
    "quantidade",
    "data_venda",
    "valor",
    "ativo"
  FROM "n1"
), "n3" AS (
  SELECT
    "uf",
    "cidade",
    "data_txt",
    "preço_txt",
    "quantidade",
    "data_venda",
    "valor",
    "ativo",
    "preço_txt" * "quantidade" AS "receita"
  FROM "n2"
), "n4" AS (
  SELECT
    "uf",
    SUM("receita") AS "receita_total",
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS "pedidos"
  FROM "n3"
  GROUP BY
    "uf"
), "n5" AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM "n4"
  ORDER BY
    "uf" COLLATE NOCASE ASC
)
SELECT
  *
FROM "n5"
